notes.title: From Beyond: Ancient Echoes Update - Out Now!
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="a4HgJ8ZvT7Y;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hello everybody!

The "Ancient Echoes" update is now available, and with it, we've got some new skins, a login bonus, some new streaming drops, and more.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/d96ba3d7d65ad5e752a2b614bc3578e1cb385b85.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Highlights Include: [/b]

Additions[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Added a Fumarole area where an old companion of the Ancients will appear during the Shadow Rift.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Giant Whirlpool, which tends to pull everything down with it.[/p][list][*][p]Caves must be enabled for it to appear.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added hidden rooms in the Caves that can be explored to uncover Ancient lore, that is if you can find the entrance…[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Quality of Life[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]Woodie’s Wooden Walking Stick no longer consumes durability when its wearer is not moving.[/p][/*][*][p]Birds now have death sounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Bird sounds will disappear from the turf ambience for most of the Post-Lunar Hail period.[/p][/*][*][p]Bridges may now be placed in the Labyrinth Maze.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]New Skins![/b][/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/a10ee0bc183496b836a037bd18cb8f765186e192.png"][/img][/p][p]“Swampy Vacation Chest” ($12.99usd)[/p][p]“This Swampy Vacation Chest contains the Swamp-Lover's Chest and the Vacation Chest.”[/p][p]“Complete Survivor Chest” ($15.99usd)
“This Complete Survivor Chest contains the complete Survivor series of survivor skins.”[/p][p]

[b]New Login Bonus![/b][/p][p] [/p][p align="center"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/8378a32c2a1249deb18f89745053a87afdb2e769.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]For a limited time, players will receive the Mythic Bone Armor just by logging into the game. This is a limited-time item, don't miss out![/p][p] [/p][p]
[b]New Streaming Drops[/b][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/8addfa974314d10a0bbf806718a941e3d7abd147.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The Global Deconstruction Staff skin been added to the Orbital Collection. [url="http://klei.gg/currentdrop"]Check out the post for more details[/url].

Our Ambassadors have also been given a bunch of new codes to give away. Including Starter Packs, The Full Victorian Collection, and two new Resurrected skins, the Resurrected Glom Pack and the Resurrected Deerclops Duffel!

[b]Rhymes With Play[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/7ed630e17bbdf08f3292b771a7c81093fc5cdb49.jpg"][/img]We've got a dev stream coming up later today. Join us over at [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://twitch.tv/kleientertainment"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] and hang out with us as we discuss the new update and what's to come.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Don't Starve Franchise Sale
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/1e1488269ec33e1517f6d82a623b3adceb606d5d.jpg"][/img]
If you're here, it's pretty likely you already have everything you need. But if you don't, check out the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/dontstarvefranchise"]Don't Starve Franchise Sale[/url] for some of our best deals of the year!

[b]And that's all for now - kinda.[/b]
We've got more coming for you very soon. We're heading into the seasonal event schedule soon, and we have an update for Hallowed Nights as well as Winter's Feast, which will also include updates to existing content that we want to release before Lunar New Year, and then we will get back to the conclusion of the shadow arc early next year. So, lots happening. For those of you looking for a points code, it's here somewhere. It's been a little while since we were hiding things properly. Consider it practice. Consider it practice. [/p][p] ​[/p]

notes.title: From Beyond: Ancient Echoes Update Coming Next Week!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/1b3d4547d2baab123ae91eee0b860cb8e88724ee.png[/img]

The "Ancient Echoes" update is coming next Thursday, September 18th!

[h2]Highlights Include:[/h2]

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list][*] Added a Fumarole area where an old companion of the Ancients will appear during the Shadow Rift.
[*] Added a Giant Whirlpool, which tends to pull everything down with it.
[*] Caves must be enabled for it to appear.
[*] Added hidden rooms in the Caves that can be explored to uncover Ancient lore, that is if you can find the entrance…
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life[/h3]
[list]
[*] Woodie’s Wooden Walking Stick no longer consumes durability when its wearer is not moving.
[*] Birds now have death sounds.
[*] Bird sounds will disappear from the turf ambience for most of the Post-Lunar Hail period.
[*] Bridges may now be placed in the Labyrinth Maze.
[/list]
As always, we'll also be bringing new skins, new streaming drops, a new login reward, and more... Stay Tuned!

notes.title: Hotfix 675312
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Friendly Terramites no longer destroy Scared Stiff plants or hammerable structures.
[*] Friendly Terramites are no longer untargetable.  (Damage is converted to usage loss.)
[*] Hound waves will try to avoid players in the arena when there is an active boss.
[*] Celestial Scion now has a smaller aggro radius to re-engage it after a wipe.
[*] Updated Thermalock Missile targeting:
[list]
[*] Heat sources are now prioritized over temperature values, and will be targeted even when the ambient temperature is very high.
[*] Dropping below freezing temperature will mask your heat signature completely.
[*] More dynamic search area when retargeting.  This means that if a heat source was out of range initially, you might still be able to run over to it and have the missile retarget it now.
[/list]
[*] Thermal Stone and Thermbell will now update their heat state visually when moving in or out of an Ice Crystaleyezer zone.
[*] Drowning in shallow water will now just pick the closest shore without randomization.
[*] Updated strings and audio.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Judge’s Booth could end up in an unbreakable state.
[*] Fixed bug with Inimical Gestalts not despawning.
[*] Fixed bug with Inimical Gestalts hurting other Gestalts with their AOE attacks.
[*] Fixed reversed logic when Grainy Transmission asks for a different type of captured Gestalt.
[*] Fixed bug where Celestial Scion’s moveset did not reset when its health resets.
[*] Fixed bug where Thermalock Missiles were unable to target WX-78 even without Refrigerant Circuit.
[*] Fixed bug where Thermbells were never damaged when hit by Thermalock Missiles.
[*] Fixed bug with Warblers flying out of bounds and falling in water.
[*] Fixed bug with friendly Terramites continuing to target other Terramites that have already been picked up.
[*] Fixed bug where Merms did not stop moving when players were trying to heal them
[/list]

notes.title: "Hostile Takeover" Update Now Available! + Klei Fest
notes.content:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="bjpBhcbj6bo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Wagstaff, the Cryptic Founder, has always pushed the boundaries of this unnatural world. It’s no surprise when the world pushes back — culminating in a cataclysmic conclusion to the lunar arc.

The Hostile Takeover update is live on Steam now. The console release has been delayed about a week and we will have it for Xbox and PlayStation as soon as we can. We'll post more details when we get them.  

[b]Highlights Include:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New boss and conclusion to the Lunar questline[/p][/*][*][p]Wandering Trader[/p][/*][*][p]Ocean drowning QoL[/p][/*][*][p]Structure Alignment options[/p][/*][*][p]New controller scheme options[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, we'll also be bringing new skins, new streaming drops, a special Klei Fest login reward, and more!

[b]New Skins![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/f18e4939d8e58cd9ca57ddf7474baa1934d36b97.png"][/img][/p][p]We've got a bunch of cool new skins for you this update and as always, these skins are added to the drop pool and can be weaved using spool. We're also finally bringing the much requested Resurrected Crabpack to the shop and adding the Resurrected Meepsack as well! If you want to get one of those for free, check out our [url="https://forums.kleientertainment.com/ambassador-list/"]Ambassadors[/url] that are giving them away![/p]

[expand type=details]
[b]“Moonbound Survivors Chest, Part III” ($4.99)[/b]
“This Moonbound Chest contains skins for: Woodie, Wortox, and Wurt.”

“This Moonbound Knight Chest contains Brightshade Paladin Helm, Brightshade Paladin Armor, Brightshade Raider Helm, and Brightshade Raider Armor.”
[b]“Stampeder Duds Chest” ($4.99)[/b]
“This Stampeder Duds Chest contains skins for: Wanda, Wigfrid, and Wes.”
[b]“Moonbound Stampeders Chest” ($9.99)[/b]
“This Moonbound Stampeders Chest contains Woodie, Wortox, and Wurt's Moonbound skin items, and Wanda, Wigfrid, and Wes's Stampeder Duds skin items.”
[b]“Mystic Moonbound Stampeder Gear 'n' Duds Chest” ($18.99 / 34 RMB)
[/b]“This Mystic Moonbound Stampeder Gear 'n' Duds Chest contains the Mystic Medley Chest, Moonbound Knight Chest, Stampeder Gear Chest, Woodie, Wortox, and Wurt's Moonbound skin items, and Wanda, Wigfrid, and Wes's Stampeder Duds skin items.” 
[b]“Crabpack Resurrected Chest” ($9.99)[/b] “This Resurrected Chest contains a Crabpack.” [b]“Meepsack ResurrectedChest” ($9.99)[/b] “This Resurrected Chest contains a Meepsack.”[/expand]

[p][b]Login Rewards![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/bbf3ade88a0bc0b787d30d1fcfcc0efc9dfcd6ff.png"][/img][/p][p]For a limited time, pick up the Spikeful Terramite and Gilded Terrimite skins and the Klei Fest 2025 Ceilidh Tammie just by logging into the game!

[b]Steaming Drops![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/137f1fd02ea2dcaf8ab7002396cedd57285e9075.png"][/img][/p][p]The Gathering Amulet skin for the Lazy Forager starts our new Orbital Collection. Check out the post for more details.[/p][p]
[b]Klei Fest![/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/8ff10eaed4848b357bdc6991939606e949d57530.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our annual publisher sale is back! We've got a bunch of updates and discounts for you. [/p][list][*][p]An free base game update for Oxygen Not Included including bug fixes, QOL changes, and a new building![/p][/*][*][p]The Release of [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3655420/Oxygen_Not_Included_The_Prehistoric_Planet_Pack/"]The Prehistoric Planet Pack[/url] DLC for Oxygen Not Included[/p][/*][*][p]The Lowest prices ever for many Klei Entertainment games[/p][/*][*][p]Including the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42085/Klei_Fest_Bundle_2025"]Klei Fest Bundle[/url] for an [b]additional 40% off![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Announcing [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168390/Away_Team/"]Away Team[/url] - A new game set in the Oxygen Not Included Universe![/p][/*][*][p]Localization updates for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1304610/Lab_Rat/"]Lab Rat[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1864950/Beastieball/"]Beastieball[/url] has a big new Milestone update including new team titles, new language support, new Beastie animations and more![/p][/*][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073250/Rift_of_the_NecroDancer/"]Rift of the Necrodancer[/url] + Hatsune Miku DLC release. 6 songs + 1 free track![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Check out the sale page here: [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/kleifest2025"]https://store.steampowered.com/sale/kleifest2025[/url]

[b]We've also announced our new game - Away Team![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6yT2k6RjTuo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Away Team[/b] is a new Oxygen Not Included adventure. Take control of a duplicant and harness a new world where every tile is simulated.[/p][p][/p][p]Mistakenly shipped off on a research rocket, you find yourself in a strange new world where you must take control of the simulation to survive and thrive.[/p][p][/p][p]The world reacts to your every action. Harness chemical reactions, fine-grained temperature simulation and convection, liquids that evaporate, and more.[/p][p][/p][p]You will need to design and construct solutions to process, refine and build your way out of this ordeal in order to survive and complete your mission imperatives.[/p][p] [/p][p]Oh, and maybe a little oxygen is included.[/p][p] [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168390/Away_Team/"]Check it out on Steam and Wishlist now![/url][/p][p] [/p][p][b]That's all for now![/b]
[url="https://accounts.klei.com/link/KleiFest2025"]Klei Fest[/url] is now in full swing, but we aren't quite finished with what we wanted to get in for this update, so you can look forward to a little bit more hitting beta some time soon. After that, we're back at it for an update we expect in mid-September, and of course, with an intermission about 6 weeks from now.[/p][p] [/p][p]We'll see you soon![/p]

notes.title: [Game Update] - 662447
notes.content:
Fan mail comes in all shapes and sizes, many with heartfelt expressions of enjoyment. But one of the most inquisitive questions a fan asked was the following: "What would Wilson look like without his beard?" Since no one has ever witnessed this before, we had an artist draw it to see what this could look like.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/8f4a7d19bc95c9bddee471e5cfc926062336fdde.png[/img]
The results were varied when it was shown to the team. A few adverted their eyes, some gasps, and the one who always sits in the back presented a broad grin. One of the more learned here was reminded of a toy from their youth. A simple device used to draw hair onto a face by moving some metal shavings with a magnet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/66ef3dfe419ab5d8b697510d4559193edae78c96.png[/img]
Once started on memory lane, other memories like to resurface. Antics with friends. Time spent waiting for the perfect punch line delivery. A story that ensnares your interest. Joke books full of gadgets that claim to mystify and delight your friends with their use.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/7e380fc64fdc0e1e672cc76a8ce9792cb0439615.png[/img]
Why share this fan mail now? Well it is that time of year where yarns are weaved, tales are told, and pranks afoot. Some truth, some misdirection, but all in good fun.

So we hope you enjoy this small peak into our mail bag left by a prankster from the past. Which leads us to the present. Three, to be precise. Now, you can enjoy all of the drawn above illustrations in the game and will be given to you upon logging in.

notes.title: Skill Spotlight: Walter, Wendy & Wortox (Available Now!)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Ah2IMwOg8Sw;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Don't Starve Together: Walter, Wendy & Wortox Skill Spotlight [/b]
Winter is nearly over but the season of survival never ends, and there's something still waiting under the skill tree for the naughty, and the nice!

[b]Highlights:[/b]
[list][*]Walter Skill Tree added.[/*][*]Wendy Skill Tree added.[/*][*]Wortox Skill Tree Added. [/*][*]Some beefalo riding QoL changes[/*][*]Ranged combat hit-stun rebalancing[/*][*]Network and Physics improvements[/*][/list]
[b]New Skins:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/17546cac62cd684824bef76f4bf777ddd04b1daf.png[/img]

[b]“Archaic Attire Chest, Part III”[/b] ($4.99usd)
“This Archaic Attire Chest contains Wendy's Archaic skin set, Walter's Archaic skin set, and Wortox's Archaic skin set.”

[b]“Reliquary Chest”[/b] ($10.99usd)
“This Reliquary Chest contains the following skin items: Faint Gleam Amulet, Iterum Amulet, Qualming Amulet, Robustum Amulet, Reaping Amulet, Sepulchral Amulet, Ornate Bone Armor, Ornate Bone Helm, Twisted Star Caller's Staff, Twisted Moon Caller's Staff, Layered Dreadstone Wall, Recondite Deserter, and Ornate Night Light.”

[b]“Favorite Things Chest, Part II” [/b]($10.99usd)
“The Favorite Things Chest includes the following belongings skins: Beach House Sisturn and Nested Sisturn; Axe n' Chain, Broad Axe, Lucille Alfresco, and Punk-Axe; Lavish Scanalyzer and Utility Scanalyzer; Armoire Nomade, Fine Chef Pouch, Kitchen Scraps Sack, and Twined Chef Pouch; Cast Iron, Porcelain, Silver, and Stoneware Grinding Mills; Cast Iron, Porcelain, Silver, and Stoneware Crock Pots; Cast Iron, Porcelain, Silver, and Stoneware Seasoning Stations; Thorny, Wasteland, Wicker, and Woodland Slingshots; and Bad Dog and Best in Show.”

[b]Introducing "Resurrected" Skins[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/2fd3f18e88ccb744697d702842a5a9e7e8bc6a05.jpg[/img]

We have skins that are no longer available because they are proof of purchase rewards on official merch that are no longer for sale. We want to make these available to players but do not want to disrupt the inherent value that they have by their rarity and cost to acquire. We also have players that cannot get these skins through purchasing our merch due to issues with supply or the cost of shipping.

When introducing a new Resurrected Skin, we will give it away for a short period of time for free - through various methods. Either at that time or just a short while afterward, that skin will then also be added to the game as available for purchase based on a percentage of the original cost of the physical good that digital bonus item was linked to.

For our first Resurrected skin, we are giving a number of the Resurrected Crabpack skin codes available to ambassadors to give away in any way that they choose. It will become available for purchase in game at a later time. 

Go check out our [url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/ambassador-list/]list of Ambassadors[/url] and try to score one for yourself!

[b]One last thing. Well, technically [url=https://accounts.klei.com/link/Resurrected]two[/url]. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/625e24b12fd98269ac7cd90ef6e739a947b6b63b.png[/img]
We have been having a ton of meetings and discussions regarding the roadmap and upcoming content for DST. Ultimately, we have come to some conclusions that we are not currently able to share until after the "From Beyond" story arc is complete. 

We have two more big updates left in the arc that we expect to conclude in September. We may have teasers or - other things - as we head toward sharing these plans, but we can't share details or timing for that right now.  

As soon as we get to the point that we can share more information, a more proper content plan will be provided.

That's it for now. Thanks to everybody for all your support. 

Have fun out there!

notes.title: The Year of the Depths Worm Event is Now Available!
notes.content:
[url=https://accounts.klei.com/link/2025][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/5f12a059cbcdccb7851ec7f4e1a8f6a990d9b8ba.gif[/img][/url]

It's Lunar New Year, and we're digging deep! To mark the Year of the Depths Worm we've added a hunt for the Guilded Depths Worm, new skins, new streaming items, and a new limited-time login bonus.

[b]Highlights[/b]
[list][*]Hunt the exotic Gilded Depths Worm to harvest Lucky Gold Nuggets.[/*][*]Craft the Depths Worm Shrine and enjoy the new Jubilantern Posts along with the usual festive options.[/*][*]Collect further Lucky Gold Nuggets by scrapping with the other serpentine friends deep in the caves.[/*][/list]

[b]Skins[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/b47642401986ab6366576a8c8f679de39ba19fc4.png[/img]

Masquerader Survivors Chest, Part III ($8.99 / 16 RMB)
This Masquerader Chest contains skins for: Wendy, Winona, WX-78, Webber, and Wickerbottom.

[b]Streaming Drops![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/14f5245867c6c97fdf3884cf97dd6e9f6b5c1e05.png[/img]

The Rose Thorn Trap skin for the Tooth Trap joins the Rose collection. [url=http://klei.gg/currentdrop]Check out the post for more details[/url]

[b]Login Bonus![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/5d4b3327f65445199a39c39a470dbeaf7e2854e0.png[/img]

For a limited time players that log in during the Year of the Depths Worm event will receive the Quilted Breezy Vest when logging into the game for the first time during the event. This is a limited-time item, don't miss out!

[b]It's a new year![/b]
The hold on the Wendy, Wortox, and Walter skill update has created a scenario in which we have to juggle some updates a bit to prevent further disruption. As discussed previously, we wanted to better address the skill trees but we also have to make sure we're delivering on the other updates that we were already working on. Most of Wendy's changes are in the beta update today, leaving the Woby changes to Walters Skill trees to come a short while after. So it's going to be a bit longer before the whole update is released fully. We want to ensure that the result of the extra time spent on this update is that last year had one less update and not that this year (or both) is short an update. 

We'll have more information about when that update is going out pretty soon. 

On that note, as we do every January, we are also taking some time to look at the previous year and the year ahead of us, what we want to accomplish for the game and the studio as a whole, and how to best adjust our plans accordingly.

We're pretty much set to go and almost ready to share a new update plan (roadmap) with everybody, very soon. We're pretty excited, and we think you're going to be too. 

See you then!

notes.title: Intermission - Animated Short, Twitch Drops and More.
notes.content:
Hey everybody.

It's intermission time again; A time to sit back and reflect on adventures past and dream of adventures yet to come. 

We're glad you all enjoyed our last animated short "[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i-6-BR9JDTc]Projector[/url]". These shorts give players a peek behind the motivations of our survivors and who they are, not just where they came from or how they got here. Some may be backstories and some side stories, but today it's a little bit of both. 

[previewyoutube=ZzslPZi5AOA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Hide & Seek[/h3]
Some things, once lost, are gone forever... but how will you know for sure unless you keep searching?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/f0486b8a3dc1119d406e3be311bb27e4af65980c.png[/img]
[h3]Login Bonus[/h3]

The Catcoon Nap Sack Fur Roll skin is available as a limited time login bonus. Just log into the game to get yours!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/aef943c4541519fa6afa3266e9b0279b0ee78017.png[/img]

[h3]Twitch Drops[/h3]

The Rose Bushel Potted Fern skin is available by watching participating Ambassador streams on Twitch.tv. For more details, [url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/158793-the-rose-bushel-is-now-available-on-twitchtv/]check out the post here[/url]. 
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/4a87d8da62e5238417cb4225a1028022195423a6.png[/img]

[h3]New Vignettes[/h3]

A selection of Vignettes has been added to the game as well. Keep up those vignette suggestions when you see them and we'll keep adding them. 

[h3]And that's it![/h3]
There are no Klei Points today. Instead, for Intermissions we're going to be giving you spool. So - pick out something nice for yourself, [url=https://accounts.klei.com/link/IntermissionAnimationHideAndSeek]it's on us[/url]. 

The team is currently working on a bunch of Cave content for you. We can't quite call this one a QOL - this is shadow related content that will introduce a bunch of new threats and rewards to the caves.  

We'll want to talk about that pretty soon, so in a few weeks, we'll have some more information for you. Maybe in a post, maybe a stream, maybe a beta? Who knows what we'll do?! Well, we do. But we'll tell you later. 

Have fun out there!

notes.title: Hotfix 620060
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Charming Salt Tin has been made slightly taller to fit the salt box profile.
[*] Followers will no longer destroy Exotic Trees.
[*] Winona’s Shadow Seeker II will now work on Big Slimy Pits in the Caves.
[*] Calibrated Perceiver will now work on most things that change prefabs when deployed or used.

[*] Crab Guards and Knights improved sleep resistance also starts at 5 purple gems now.

[*] Fixed Crab King’s Cannon Towers shooting out visually different projectiles when they do not create leaks.
[*] Fixed Crab King’s Cannon Towers not getting reduced boat collision damage from Yellow Gems.
[*] Fixed world generation layout for repeat generations being deviant from world seed.
[*] Fixed Roses spawned by the Ancient Fuelweaver or Winona getting added to world regrowth.
[*] Fixed Mushrooms changing form by Ghosts Haunting them getting added to world regrowth.

[*] Fixed swapping a deployable item with a regular item making the item's inventory icon invisible.
[*] Fixed Calibrated Perceiver and Blueprints not learning new recipes while under Wickerbottom’s The Everything Encyclopedia book effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 618572
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Merm Tools can’t be used by players.
[*] Bat Bat can now drain life from most things again.
[*] Lowered waterproofness and removed insulation from Portasol.
[*] Added new rain sounds for Portasol.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Crab Guards and Crab Knights failing to abandon breaking ice floes.
[*] Fixed the Bootleg not working with controllers.
[*] Fixed bug where Winona could not Dismount from a Beefalo using controllers while holding a Portasol.
[*] Fixed Winona getting wetness locked after being saved from death.
[*] Fixed bug with W.I.N.bot resetting its spawn point whenever it goes offscreen.
[*] Fixed bug where dismantling a Spotlight does not clear its last target.
[*] Fixed bug with incorrect fuel state when Winona’s generators are used to charge WX-78.
[*] Fixed bug where Wagstaff’s Cacheboxes can get stuck if you take your Inspectacles off while it’s giving out loot.
[*] Fixed snow and other ground effects accumulating on Vine Bridges.
[*] Fixed missing cuff symbols in the Close Examine animation.
[*] Fixed a crash related to BERNIE! Shrinking size.
[*] Fixed a Wortox inspection line typo.
[*] Fixed Wurt’s announce line for sheltering.
[*] Merms will no longer use tools (that do less damage) to fight.
[*] Fixed Shoddy Tools turning invisible when floating.
[*] Fixed Mutant Merm duplicating when they are attacked by their leader.
[*] Fixed a second Merm spawning when a Lunar Merm reverts back to a regular Merm.
[*] Fixed crash sometimes when colliding with Salt Formations.
[*] Fixed irreplaceable items being destroyed by Powder Monkey raids.
[*] Fixed projectiles launched from Boats having the Boat’s velocity added to them in the wrong direction.
[*] Fixed entities teleported off Boats not showing up for some clients.
[*] Fixed buildings being blocked from being built near things that are fading out after dying.
[*] Fixed broken Hound Mounds and chopped down Driftwood blocking your path.
[*] Fixed some talking animations for Wurt’s Guest of Honor and Archaic skins.
[*] Fixed Crossbones Trawler skin missing part of its shadow.
[*] Fixed Superior Communal Kelp Dish scrapbook picture size.
[*] Fixed missing cold particles for the Robin Egg Ice Box skin.
[*] Fixed glassed full moon icon art.
[*] Fixed some errors in Pig and Prime Mate art.
[/list]
[b]Notes for Modders[/b]
[list]
[*] Component function sanity_replica IsSane now properly returns the result.
[/list]

notes.title: From Beyond: Staying Afloat + Skill Spotlight: Wurt and Winona
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=MaZotfhJZWs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Staying Afloat[/h3]

While Wurt and Winona hammer away on their own visions for the future, it seems the Constant's sea has seen some changes of its own. Be prepared to rock the boat in the name of progress!

[b]Highlights Include:[/b]
[list][*][b]Skill Spotlight: [/b]Wurt and Winona Skillsets have been added.[/*]
[*][b]Crab King redesign: [/b]new behaviors, minions, arena, and loot.[/*]
[*][b]Sunken Chests: [/b]added new exclusive loot - Surprising Seeds and Archaic Boats.[/*]
[*][b]Marotters: [/b]new creatures found on the coastline.[/*]
[*][b]Additional Pirate Raid behavior:[/b] they can sometimes be found post-raid, carrying loot.[/*]
[*]Kelp Boat Patch, signs of Powder Monkeys territory on sea stacks, new ocean set pieces, a new Pearl trade, and a new Salt Lick made of actual salt![/*][/list]

[h3]New Skins![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/9f96470ceae6d9f57f08093f8dcc145b4ed89c86.png[/img]

Who says you can't always get what you want? As always, these skins also can be weaved with spool and drop in-game, but see the spoiler below for more info on the new skins available in this update. 
[expand type=details]
[b]“Intrepid Chest”($5.99usd)[/b]
“This Intrepid Chest contains the following skin items: Gilded Birdcage, Tallbird Eyebrella, Barbarous Helmet, Dark Talisman, Electric Eel, and Foreboding Furnace.”

[b]“Cottage Cache Chest, Part II” ($5.99usd)[/b]
“This Cottage Cache, Part II Chest contains the following skin items: Cottage Crock Pot, Robin Egg Ice Box, Charming Salt Tin, Cloth Wrap, Hand-Carved Post, Rustic Post, Artisan Post, and Charming Cooler Chest.”

[b]“Gardener Chest” ($5.99usd)[/b]
“This Gardener Chest contains the following skin items: Beewitching Hat, Fetching Bug Net, Beespoke Garden Hoe, Vintage Apiary, Foraging Sack, and Quaint Seed Purse.”

[b]“Swashbuckler Loot Chest” ($5.99usd)[/b]
“This Swashbuckler Loot Chest contains the following skin items: Piratin' Bin, Makeshift Mast, Pirate Sloop, Scallywag Raft, Crossbones Trawler, and Pilferin' Winch.”

[b]“Archaic Artifacts Chest, Part II” ($14.99usd)[/b]
“This Archaic Artifacts Chest contains all the belongings skins from the Intrepid Chest, the Cottage Cache Chest, Part II, the Gardener Chest, and the Swashbuckler Loot Chest.”

[b]“Archaic Attire Chest, Part II” ($5.99usd)[/b]
“This Archaic Attire Chest contains Winona's Archaic skin set, Willow's Archaic skin set, Wurt's Archaic skin set, and Wigfrid's Archaic skin set.”

[b]“Archaic Array Chest” ($16.99usd)[/b]
“This Archaic Array Chest contains all the belongings skins from the Archaic Artifacts Chest, Part II and the Archaic Attire Chest, Part II.”
[/expand]
[h3]Klei Fest![/h3]
In case you missed it, we have a bunch of stuff on sale right now for Klei Fest and we're offering our best sales of the year!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/kleifest2024][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/e2c6c8d20e2e17aaa7b3cbd7bf13b3720c3ee6d2.png[/img][/url]

[b]Highlights include:[/b]
[list]
[*]DST, DS, and ONI owners can score an additional discount on Mind Over Magic with new Colony Sim and Base Builder bundles.[/*]
[*]Invisible, Inc. turns 10 this year and we're celebrating with an Anniversary Bundle for -90% off![/*]
[*]Get every Klei game in the Klei Fest exclusive Klei Fest Bundle for an additional 50% off[/*]
[*]already discounted prices![/*][*]Get the lowest prices ever on Griftlands, Hot Lava, Mark of the Ninja, and several bundles![/*]
[*]We've also got some new cross-publisher bundles featuring Cobalt Core, Dwarf Fortress, and more.[/*][/list]
Check out the sale page here: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/kleifest2024

[h3]Streaming Drops![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/ecd3289bb56ba47bd2f395fcea1029db6a3b37b1.png[/img]
The Rosy Eyebrella joins the Rose collection. [url=http://klei.gg/currentdrop]Check out the post for more details[/url]

[h3]Rhymes With Play![/h3]

[url=http://klei.gg/currentdrop][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/1ec954fe9102cc667b5170ef56d7a99d3e397339.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Klei Points![/h3]
https://accounts.klei.com/link/ShiftySeaSwindlers

[h3]And that's all for now![/h3]
We hope that you all enjoy the update. We'll have more news on things to come in a few weeks. We'll probably throw in a teaser or two. Who knows?

notes.title: Klei Fest! - New Skill Trees and Staying Afloat Update Next Thursday!
notes.content:
[table noborder=1][tr][td][hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=aABhkd0ea1Y;full][/previewyoutube]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][h2]
Don't Starve Together - New Skill Trees and Staying Afloat Update Next Thursday!
[/h2][/td][/tr][tr][td]
No matter where you find yourself stranded, survival is better with friends by your side. Thank you for joining us through 11 years of Don't Starve!

It's been an amazing adventure with our community through 11 years of Don't Starve. For this year's Klei Fest We wanted to take a little trip through the past as we look toward the future. 

The new update for Don't Starve Together launches next week on June 27th at 10am pacific time. 

Highlights Include:
[list][*][b]Skill Trees[/b]: Wurt and Winona Skill Trees have been added. 
[*][b]Crab King redesign[/b]: new behaviors, minions, arena and loot.
[*][b]Sunken Chests[/b]: added new exclusive loot - Surprising Seeds and Archaic Boats.
[*][b]Marotters[/b]: new creatures found on the coast line.
[*][b]Additional Pirate Raid behavior[/b]: they can sometimes be found post raid, carrying loot.
[*]Kelp Boat Patch, signs of Powder Monkeys territory on sea stacks, new ocean set pieces, a new Pearl trade and a new Salt Lick made of actual salt![/list]

This update is currently on the beta branch, so if you're interested go check out the beta forum here: [url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/forum/208-dont-starve-together-beta-branch/]https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/forum/208-dont-starve-together-beta-branch/[/url]

As always, we've also got some new skins and a new Twitch drop coming as well. 

If you missed the news, we're bringing Don't Starve Together (with help from our friends at Playdigious), Rotwood, and Chump Squad's Lab Rat to Netflix Games! Check it out in the official announcement trailer below. 

[previewyoutube=34zrotBxjpI;full][/previewyoutube]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[img]https://cdn.forums.klei.com/kleifest/Klei_Fest_2024_event_cover.png[/img]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][h2]
It's Klei Fest! - News and Sales!
[/h2][/td][/tr][tr][td]
Hey Everybody! Klei Fest is our annual event where we celebrate all things Klei with some great discounts and game updates. This year we've got a lot cooking. We have never had so much exciting stuff to look forward to, and we've always got [i]something[/i] coming soon. We have news for Rift of the Necrodancer, Mind over Magic has an exciting update, Oxygen Not Included is bringing news for their upcoming DLC, Rotwood has an update AND news on their first new hunt and DST is finishing up beta on their next big update! We also have some fun animated shorts to share!

In addition we're offering our best sales of the year. Highlights include:
[list][*]DST, DS, and ONI owners can score an additional discount on Mind Over Magic with new Colony Sim and Base Builder bundles.
[*]Invisible, Inc. turns 10 this year and we're celebrating with an Anniversary Bundle for -90% off!
[*]Get every Klei game in the Klei Fest exclusive Klei Fest Bundle for an additional 50% off [b]already discounted prices![/b]
[*]Get the lowest prices ever on Griftlands, Hot Lava, Mark of the Ninja, and several bundles!
[*]We've also got some new cross-publisher bundles featuring Cobalt Core, Dwarf Fortress and more.[/list]
[/td][/tr][/table]
This sale is so jam packed, you're going to want to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/kleifest2024]Check out the sale page here![/url]

[table noborder=1][tr][td][hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=sJpRHJFYriE;full][/previewyoutube]
[/td][/tr][tr][td][h2]
Rotwood - New Powers Update and Tundra Beta News!
[/h2][/td][/tr][tr][td]
Today we're adding nearly twenty new Powers available from the start of the game.

These new powers are intended to add some variations to your runs in the earlier portions of the game and will help us transition into the release of our first new Hunt!

What’s next?
We will be opening up a beta branch for the next Hunt: Bonechill Quarry next week! This includes a completely new environment, a new Boss Rot and Rot Miniboss, new enemies, new armour and weapons, more new Powers, new decorations, bug fixes, and a familiar friend who has found their voice.

With the new hunt we will also be sharing an updated roadmap that will describe our update schedule and content plans!

We also have a Rhymes with Play stream today! We'll be showing off the some of the newest update and what you can look forward too with the the upcoming Hunt!

Join us at 3:30pm Pacific time on Twitch at https://twitch.tv/kleientertainment. Or for more details, check out the announcement [yrl=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/157325-rotwood-rhymes-with-play-dev-cast-this-thursday/]here[/url]. 

See you soon!

Oxygen Not Included - A New Animated Short & DLC News!
[/h2][/td][/tr][tr][td]
There's a new ONI short! The Dupes are gearing up to explore an icy new planet, but one crew member finds the prospect of this adventure rather...chilling. Will the colony keep its cool? Or will dire warnings derail this mission?

We will be opening up a beta branch for the next Hunt: Bonechill Quarry next week! This includes a completely new environment, a new Boss Rot and Rot Miniboss, new enemies, new armour and weapons, more new Powers, new decorations, bug fixes, and a familiar friend who has found their voice.
The Frosty Planet Pack features a new sub-zero starting asteroid with new biomes, new buildings, and new critters so cute, your colony might temporarily forget how cold they are.
This Major Update enhances Mage progression, introducing Apprenticeships, Mage Level, Relics, Quirks, and Wand upgrading.

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=4nScU3241lo;full][/previewyoutube]
	[h3]Scrappy Scavengers[/h3]
	One person's junk is another's armament. An old foe from below returns, hungry for a new source of power[url=https://accounts.klei.com/link/unlimitedpower].[/url] Have you enough courage to challenge him for it?

	[b]Highlights Include:[/b]
[list]	[*]		Skill Tree updates for Wigfrid, Willow, and Wormwood. 	[/*]	[*]		Performance improvements and item management features for late game and megabases.	[/*]	[*]		Two new Moon Shroom items. 	[/*]	[*]		Acid rain update	[/*]	[*]		New location with a new NPC encounter	[/*]	[*]		Much more! 	[/*][/list]
	[h3]New Skins![/h3]	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/5f4db9ba7a1f0061f9a72cbe59098e90bf744ce4.png[/img]

	“Moonbound Survivors Chest, Part II” ($4.99usd)
	“This Moonbound Chest contains skins for: Warly, Wes, and Willow.”

	[h3]New Streaming Drops![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/9d1f76bdaf0e3130cce5fc91c719f6d87d1fe4c1.png[/img]
	 
	The Rosy Red Cane joins the Rose collection. [url=http://klei.gg/currentdrop]Check out the post for more details[/url]

	[h3]Rhymes With Play![/h3]
	[url=https://twitch.tv/kleientertainment][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/af14eb96599dc0afd67b03acae4504ad846eedeb.png[/img][/url]

	[h3]And Introducing![/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/afd02e3a72482b9bb2cf96160eddd74f722a1309.jpg[/img]
[h3]	Don't Starve: The Board Game[/h3]
	[b]Glass Cannon Unplugged[/b] are pleased to announce that they will be responsible for bringing to the world the official board game adaptation of the award-winning video game [b]Don’t Starve[/b], as part of a long-term licensing partnership with [b]Klei Entertainment[/b].

	Designed by Rafał Pieczyński—lead developer of the highly acclaimed and multi-award-winning Frostpunk:The Board Game, with narrative direction by Jakub Wiśniewski—known for his work on This War Of Mine and Frostpunk:The Board Game—and Natanel Vo-Apfel of Into The Outside: Prelude fame, [b]Don't Starve: The Board Game[/b] transports 1-4 players into the unrelenting, randomly generated nightmare world of the Constant, a distant and ominous realm where magic and science intertwine in ways better left unspoken. Pitched against the elements and a grim pantheon of baddies, the players assume the roles of iconic characters from the video game, having to work closely together and use their wits to outsmart fate, strive for subsistence and simply stay alive.

	With its mechanics highlighting [b]player choice, dynamic combat[/b], and [b]open-world exploration[/b] in night and day conditions, Don't Starve: The Board Game is bound to transcend to unexplored levels of immersion, with its visual design fully embracing the unique, whimsical [b]art style[/b] long cherished by fans of the series.

	The game will be made available through a Kickstarter crowdfunding campaign that is expected to fully utilize the creative potential of the source material, with a wealth of content offered via [b]expansions, add-ons[/b] and future retail releases.

	We've been working closely with the team over at Glass Cannon Unplugged to help them create a truly interesting and fresh tabletop game but also very much Don't Starve, and we think you're all going to love it. Subscribe to the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/glasscannonunplugged/dont-starve-the-board-game?ref=2wl0wx]Kickstarter preview page[/url] if you want to stay on top of the project. 

	[b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/glasscannonunplugged/dont-starve-the-board-game?ref=2wl0wx]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/glasscannonunplugged/dont-starve-the-board-game?ref=2wl0wx[/url][/b]

	[h3]And that's all for now![/h3]
	A big thanks to everybody who participated in the beta for this update, we appreciate all your feedback and bug reports.
	 
	We're already working on our next update, but I don't have information to share about it yet. Once we do, we'll be sure to share it here as soon as possible. But for now, we hope you enjoy the Scrappy Scavengers update.

notes.title: Roadmap 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/5f92abf7fb048a0b4828a98d0789a4896cd0b2a5.png[/img]
[h3]It’s Roadmap Time![/h3]

[b]NOTE:[/b] This roadmap is provided to let players know what our current plans are for the year. As a studio, we constantly re-evaluate and adjust as necessary, so this is not a guarantee of upcoming content and these plans may change. We will do our best to communicate these changes if they come along, but we try our best to see our roadmaps through to completion.

[h3]2023 Recap[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/322330/view/3681168325290998236]For 2023 our goal[/url] was to further build up systems in the game that would allow us to add challenges for existing players but also make the game a bit less opaque for new players and deliver on some common player expectations of a multiplayer game. 

We added skill trees for Wilson, Willow, Wigfrid, Woodie, Wolfgang and Wormwood. We added the scrapbook to help players learn more about the world and new end game content with new challenges and equipment. 

We also had a fun crossover event with Cult of the Lamb, finished adding shared unlocks for all platforms as well as all of our usual holiday events. 

We're pretty happy with the progress we have made but we went through a few pain points along the way that we want to address with this roadmap. 
 
[h3]What’s coming up?[/h3]
For 2024 we are going to continue these, but we have decided to change our update process for this year. We’re going to have longer periods between updates in order to have more substantial and impactful gameplay updates. 

We have been working toward this goal for the past several months and this roadmap is where we will start with a newer schedule. With our new schedule [b]we will be releasing 4 major updates[/b]; each containing a mix of QOL, content and additional character updates. In between these updates we will be releasing new [b]lore shorts[/b], new skins and occasional news on their own just to keep things from being too quiet for too long. 

I think it’s important to make some clarifications here. We have been doing frequent and regular updates since Don’t Starve originally debuted on the Chrome web store in 2011. We believe the cadence of these updates has helped our games remain fresh and interesting but also helps us build strong community interest. We are pretty apprehensive about this change as we are concerned that the time between updates could slow the community down. So we will be watching closely and making adjustments as needed in the future.

This isn’t a massive change, but it is a change and we think the result will be a much more enjoyable experience for players overall.

It’s also worth mentioning that we have not changed staffing or output at any level of production. This is an adjustment purely for providing more comprehensive updates, not an effort to reduce or otherwise shift resources on these updates.

It should be said that less frequent updates mean less update prep which should allow a bit more time working directly on each update, but I don’t want to set expectations too high here. Don’t Starve Together has become a massive game with a lot of moving parts, and it takes us a bit more time to put things together than it did in the past. The point is that you’re still getting the same amount of content in this roadmap, just not as frequent.  

[h3]Anything else?[/h3]
This is going to take us a little bit of time to get into the swing of things, but also going to try to do a bit more to communicate future updates to players while you're waiting. This may come in the way of forum posts or streams, but you will see a bit more information as we near release so people can see the game is being worked on. 

This will begin after our update in February. 

[h3]That’s it for now[/h3]
We have the Year of the Dragonfly coming February 8th and after that we have a QOL+More update coming at the end of March. We’ll share more information as soon as we can. 

See you soon! - https://accounts.klei.com/link/2024Roadmap

notes.title: Winter's Feast is Here & Skill Spotlight Coming Next Week!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/867f894ecc48db746b7ee02c190bfed3f502c3c3.png[/img]

[h2]Winter's Feast[/h2]
Lots of festive activities provide entertainment for all our Survivors. Visit the Deerclops, See Klaus's Gem Deer! There's fun, food, and treats from the Festive Table, or start your own bakery. And lots more. Winter's feast is fun, forest, and fantasy all rolled into one!

[h3]An Uncommon Holiday[/h3]
Winter skins have appeared to get our survivors into the winter spirit, and for a limited time, the chances of receiving a rare gift have been substantially increased!

[h3]Festive Holiday Attire[/h3]
For the duration of the Winter's Feast event, players will have access to a free set of skins. The Yuletide Overcoat, Yuletide Frock, Jingly Tophat, Gingerbread Chest, and the Plum Pudding Cap.

[h2]Historically Accurate Don't Starve Holiday Cards[/h2]
We just got finished with round 1 of our annual Winter Game Jam. Jen, a writer on Don't Starve Together experimented with making some historically accurate Don't Starve Themed holiday cards and while we don't normally share things we make during the game jam, we thought that you might make good use of them. [url=https://kleiforums.s3.amazonaws.com/holiday2023/wierdsnowman.jpg]Snowman[/url] - [url=https://kleiforums.s3.amazonaws.com/holiday2023/wobsterrat.jpg]WobsterRat[/url] - [url=https://kleiforums.s3.amazonaws.com/holiday2023/afraid.jpg]Afraid[/url] - [url=https://kleiforums.s3.amazonaws.com/holiday2023/radishworm.jpg]RadishWorm[/url]

[h2]And next week - December 19th[/h2]
We want to get it out to you a bit earlier than our regular Thursday update so we have time to get things fixed up before we head out to holiday break and so we will be releasing our "Skill Spotlight: Wigfrid & Willow" next week a bit early on Tuesday December 19th. 

See you Tuesday!

notes.title: Cult of the Lamb x Don't Starve Together Crossover Now Available!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7WCg-_V3Oqs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/22280e3aaa70e85ec6fe3d8e0ab18209746307c4.png[/img][/url]
We've had our eyes on a Crossover with Cult of the Lamb for quite some time. We may have our plates full with our 2023 roadmap but we couldn't resist the temptation to do a [url=https://accounts.klei.com/link/justabite]bite-sized[/url] crossover for you all. This update will be available today on PC, Xbox and PlayStation. Nintendo Switch is currently scheduled to receive this update very soon!

[h3]Cult of the Lamb x Don't Starve Together[/h3]

Something wooly this way comes! A charming change-up is coming to the Constant, and we can hardly contain our shear excitement. You’ll have it baa-d for this culty collab!

	[b]Crossover Content[/b]
	The Crown trinket can now be found in Wet Pouches that are fished from the oasis lake.
	Offering the Crown trinket to the Antlion will reward the players with new blueprints.

	[b]Changes[/b]
	The Thermal Stone now pacifies the Antlion for 4 days.
	The Beach Toy now pacifies the Antlion for 3 days.
	Fixed the rounding errors when calculating the Antlion tribute values.
	Increased the odds of getting your first Desert Goggles Blueprint and Beach Toy from a Wet Pouch.
	
	[b]Login Rewards[/b]

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/9eb572284bb5fa6f3d3a7a506b19189da14d89f0.png[/img]

	For a limited time, log in to Don't Starve Together and get The Lamb, The Lamb's Blade, Flock's Chest, and The Lamb's Reward item skins inspired by Cult of The Lamb. 

	[b]Twitch Items [/b]

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/2fba689b95a1b28e7cc602bae01b6a0f00c9e6f5.png[/img]

	We're also dropping some new items over on Twitch inspired by Cult of the Lamb. From now until Sept. 4th you can get the Camellia Flowerbed on Twitch.tv. [url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/150547-new-streaming-drops-available-now-the-camellia-flowerbed/]Head over here for more information[/url]. 
	
	[b]And that's it for now![/b]

	A huge Thanks to Massive Monster and Devolver Digital for our time together working on this crossover. If you are not already a devoted follower,  you should check it out. You'll become a believer too!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34321/Cult_of_the_Lamb_x_Dont_Starve_Together/
	
	We're getting ready for the beta of our next update, so for now just hang tight; we'll have more info for you soon.

[h2]Skill Spotlight: Wormwood, Wolfgang, Woodie[/h2]
   
[h3] Highlights:[/h3]
[list]   [*]      Wolfgang Skillset added [/*]  [*]      Wormwood Skillset added [/*]  [*]      Woodie Skillset added   [/*]  [*]      Survivors can now craft large Support Pillars to create areas safe from quake debris and cave ins. [/*]  [*]      Equipment forged from the Brightsmithy and Shadowcraft Plinth are now no longer prototype-able but can be repaired using specific repair kits.     [list]         [*]            When they reach a fully broken state, they can no longer be equipped until repaired.         [/*]     [/list]  [/*]  [*]      Equipment changes:      [list]         [*]            Umbralla can now be activated on the ground to generate an area of effect rain barrier.  Please note that acid rain does not heal the Umbralla while it is activated like this.        [/*]        [*]            Void Cowl and Void Robe no longer provide acid rain immunity.        [/*]        [*]            Void Cowl and Void Robe no longer drain sanity when equipped.        [/*]        [*]            Ramping shadow planar damage buff now only requires equipping Void Cowl instead of the full set.         [/*]        [*]            Void Robe now blocks negative sanity auras (e.g. from monsters or other scary objects).         [/*]        [*]            Brightshade weapon buffs now only require equipping Brightshade Helm instead of the full set.         [/*]        [*]            Brightshade Helm now prevents Charlie attacks when standing in darkness.         [/*]        [*]            Brightshade Armor now has minor damage reflection.       [/*]        [*]            Dreadstone Armor and Dreadstone Helm no longer drain sanity when not self-repairing.         [/*]     [/list]  [/*][/list]

notes.title: Don't Starve Together: From Beyond - Taking Root & 10 Years of Don't Starve!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a5-sHjpO7-c][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/4e8c2bc8d0624a0ed4a5efa29fc5b3769182b398.jpg[/img][/url]
[h3]From Beyond: Taking Root[/h3]

As the power struggle between the moon and shadows escalates, the pressure is mounting for our Survivors. Loyalties will be forged and tested as new rifts start to slowly expand...

[h3]New Features[/h3]

[list]
[*] Rifts spewing lunar energy will begin to open in the world, either by defeating the Celestial Champion or by server settings.
[*] The first creatures to spew forth are very interested in gardening.
[*] New and powerful equipment can be crafted from these extra-planar thralls, with the right crafting station.
[/list]
This content is part of a 3 part set of content updates in the "From Beyond" arc and is available today on Steam, PlayStation and Xbox. Nintendo Switch will be coming soon, it takes a little longer there. 

[h3]Don't Starve Celebrates 10 Years![/h3]

Can you believe it? 10 years of Wilson, the Survivors and the Constant. From our humble beginnings as a Chrome app to well over 25 million copies all around the world and we haven't slowed down yet. Countless updates, bug reports, hot fixes, puzzles, fan art, and even some songs (Beefaloooo!). Don't Starve wouldn't be what it is today without our fans. We've watched some of you grow up and we've watched ourselves grow up.

We're not perfect, but we truly do try our hardest to do the best we can for you all and we hope you feel the same love from us that we feel from you.
 
Thank you. From all of us. 

To celebrate we have a few gifts for you. This post is going to get rather large, so hang in there with me please. 

[h3]We got together and signed a poster for you![/h3]
Unfortunately, we couldn't print and send out a poster to all 25+ million of you, but we did make a high rez poster that you can print yourself. Both a signed and unsigned original Thank You poster made for DS10 is available on the Klei Rewards page for free. We've also added another special signed and unsigned version as vignettes in Don't Starve Together. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/a00292e40e3705a777e91ffcd01ea72dc63c6e60.png[/img]

[h3]We updated the hell out of the original Don't Starve![/h3]
I literally don't know how many bugs, balance changes and QOL updates are in the new update for Don't Starve that dropped today. But it's a lot and you can get more details about that here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/be607ee2707f79006e3de23986d071d3af165cc2.jpg[/img]

Big thanks to DiogoW for joining our team with this effort. He's now our "Secret Projects" guy working on a bunch of things we've been dying to do for Don't Starve Together, and we look forward to sharing more info in the future. 

[h3]Free Anniversary Login Bonus in Don't Starve Together. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/4f0a0645d8cfd8d781619fe20cef0a258781a0a1.png[/img]

The Celebratory Science Machine and Celebratory Cake Chest are available for free for a limited time just for logging into the game. We'll add these to Klei Rewards at some point in the future, but if you want them now, go get 'em!

We also have some new skins for sale in the game. The Complete Verdant Chest and the Blooming Verdant Chest are now available. 

[h3]All the Streams![/h3]
It would be absolutely insane if we didn't take a moment to thank our streamers. And to do that we are giving our Ambassadors 10 bundle codes of item skins and a bonus code for 10k spools for Ambassadors to give to their viewers. So go head over to an Ambassador stream this weekend and check them out for your chance for one of over 3000 codes up for grabs.

[url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/ambassador-list/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/2298137bf6789ec28fd9a96afc8cedb9c9d56713.jpg[/img][/url]

We've also made a brand new Ambassador page to make it easier for you to find our Ambassador streams at any time. You can check that out at the top of the forums or this [url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/ambassador-list/]link here[/url]. 

[h3]Our own Stream![/h3]
We're also going to be hosting our own stream later today where we'll be taking about "Taking Root" and revealing some info about what's coming up in the next update and what the heck is going on in "From Beyond"

Be sure to click the follow button on the Klei Twitch channel to get alerted whenever we go live: https://www.twitch.tv/kleientertainment

[h3]New Twitch Drops![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/4b20f9ca53355801c597c0b295781b8f2d4dd628.png[/img]
We're offering a new set of streaming drops over on Twitch.tv. [url=http://klei.gg/currentdrop]Check out this post for details[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/ccf5516c7ce3cca2b523c96c2a5db6937cdb5d11.png[/img]

Brand new merch is now available in the Klei store. Available in the online store for the first time is our Puft Plush and Soft Spots! We also have a limited edition Don’t Starve 10th anniversary shirt launching today. Finally we have restocked two posters (Monster Party and Wilson Cover) and added five brand new ones (Charlie Throne & Thorns, Ultimate Survival Inventory 2.0, Griftlands Cover Art, Oxygen Not Included New Hero Art, and Don’t Starve 10th Anniversary Art). [url=https://shop.klei.com/]Pick them up while supplies last[/url]!

[h3]A hint at things to come[/h3]
We also wanted to give you a little taste of the next update. If you don't want spoilers, don't click below and just move to the next section. I know it's tempting, but be strong - you can do it, I believe in you.

 [expand type=spoiler][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/4c22ce3aca83163b2b2e47a4c37b70aad04f630c.png[/img][/expand]

[h3]I think that's it! [/h3]
It's probably also worth mentioning that all but the newest skins are on sale right now and Don't Starve Together is currently on massive discount on all platforms. (Up to 90% off!)

We're already well on our way into the next couple of updates. And we'll have more information about that soon enough. But for now, that's it for this post. As always, here's a nice [url=https://accounts.klei.com/link/herestotenmore]link for some spools[/url], just for being you. If you have any friends or family that pick up the game during the big sale, make sure to let them know because you can get a lot of great stuff with the 10k Klei Points in that link!

Till next time friends, Thank you. And have fun out there!

notes.title: Don't Starve Together: From Beyond - Taking Root Arrives Next Week April 27th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/e3ed7b089433bd7b541f7f76844c92e242e73e77.png[/img]
[b]Taking Root[/b], the first content update of the new [b]From Beyond [/b]story arc is coming next week, [b]Thursday April 27th at 10am pacific time[/b].

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Rifts spewing lunar energy will begin to open in the world, either by defeating the Celestial Champion or by server settings.
[*] The first creatures to spew forth are very interested in gardening.
[*] New and powerful equipment can be crafted from these extra-planar thralls, with the right crafting station.
[/list]
[h3]A quick note. [/h3]
As discussed in the most [url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/146496-dont-starve-together-roadmap-2023/]recent roadmap[/url], the new arc is focused on both endgame and early game content. Taking Root is the first major update in this arc and is mainly focused on the entry point of this new end game content. 

While we attempt to make sure that every major update is fun on its own (including this one), I wanted to address that this particular update won't be immediately apparent how much it will affect the overall game right away.

While Taking Root introduces some new items, abilities and creatures, the full depth of how this will all play out can not be seen immediately. This means that the balance of these items are focused around upcoming content and not necessarily intended to be direct upgrades to existing content. Since the end game portion of From Beyond is being split into 3 parts, the balance is being designed with that upcoming content in mind.

That doesn't mean we don't want bug reports and feedback, just that you should keep in mind that you don't have the whole picture yet, but it's still good for us to know your thoughts. 

Thanks to everybody for all the feedback and bug reports during the beta period. We're still working and reading so keep it coming!

[h3]DS10![/h3]
We'll also be celebrating 10 years of Don't Starve with some special discounts and surprises for everybody so don't miss it!

We also have a new animated short, some bug fixes and balance changes, and a new streaming item "[b]The Nouveau Club[/b]" as well.

See you Thursday!

notes.title: Don't Starve Together Roadmap 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/5cf2ff4e7bb9c1db039e6b630b8ff0bad7633168.png[/img]

	[b]Anybody interested in a roadmap?[/b]

	NOTE: Please remember that the roadmap is provided to give the community a sense of what we are working on and what is driving our decisions and what we are focused on in the coming year. None of this is a promise or a guarantee. We always prioritize quality over deadlines and all dates and timelines are estimated to the best of our current ability. Many long-time fans will know that we often add new things to these plans which often shifts things around a bit, so it is recommended that you avoid scheduling your vacation plans around our dates.

	This roadmap is subject to change at any time, but as we have done in the past, we will let you know if any of these plans change significantly.

	[b]2022 Recap[/b]
	Our goal for 2022 was to “[url=https://forums.kleientertainment.com/forums/topic/137084-dont-starve-together-roadmap-2022/]Set the Stage[/url]” for what was to come next for DST. 

	In the 2022 roadmap we saw the Year of the Catcoon and Bunnyman. We released refreshes for Maxwell, Wickerbottom, WX-78 and Wilson is right around the corner. We released QOL updates all over the place including a revamped Crafting UI, a redesigned Ancient Guardian, Map QOL changes, World Presets and New World Settings. 

	We introduced Shared Unlocks and Offline Skins. We added more games to the Midsummer Cawnival and we released the Curse of the Moon Quay and A Little Drama updates. 

	We released 10 sets of Twitch Drops and 50+ hotfixes with bug fixes, tweaks, and balance changes. 

	2022 was a busy year for Don’t Starve Together. While it may not have been as content heavy as some players were hoping for, the changes were necessary to prepare for 2023 and we’re ready to talk about that a bit. 

	This is going to be a pretty substantial post, so I am going to give a bit of a brief TL;DR summary first, then get into the meaty bits. Additionally, I should mention that we’re still doing a lot of experimentation and tweaks to how these plans are being implemented at the moment, so I have to be light with the details (surprise, surprise). But we want you to know what you have to look forward to. 

	[b]What’s coming up in 2023? (TL;DR)[/b]
	Our goal for the next roadmap is to smooth out the experience for less experienced players and provide longer lasting endgame challenges for veteran players.
[list]	[*]		3 Content Updates	[/*]	[*]		2 Core Game Enhancement Updates	[/*]	[*]		All the usual events	[/*]	[*]		A secret bite-sized crossover	[/*]	[*]		Don’t Starve 10 Year Celebration	[/*][/list]
	Additionally, this roadmap does not cover a full year, because the last Roadmap ran into 2023. 

	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/0b1b3e27363bb3f7504feb271d6d15da007a69ea.png[/img]

	 

	[b]What we’re doing and why. [/b]
	Don’t Starve Together is arguably one of the most challenging survival games out there right now. However some of the design principles that were used to create the original single player game can feel unnecessarily unfriendly in a multiplayer game. The original Don’t Starve was designed around the idea of players being self directed. However multiplayer isn’t always compatible with this design and was largely why we resisted multiplayer for the original Don’t Starve. 

	With DST, we have smoothed some of the rougher edges over time, but most of the focus has been on providing group based challenges up until more recently. We think there are still a few areas that we would like to see improved upon, and many, MANY of you have suggested the same. The areas that we are going to focus on in this roadmap are in early game discovery, and the late to end game loop.

	Now - before you start getting worried, know that we understand that we’re stepping into some weird territory here. Our goal isn't to make the game easier, or even to make the game harder (overall). The goal is to make the game more interesting in the ways that those who love Don’t Starve and Don’t Starve Together will enjoy while also providing people who don’t know the game more opportunities to understand what the game expects of them.. 

	But not all Don’t Starve Together players are the same. To some, DST is too easy, to some it’s too hard, and to others it “is what it is” and they don’t want it changed. Our goals here are to offer all players something interesting, fun and engaging and to improve the game in areas we think will have a lasting impact. This roadmap should result in a game that is easier to understand and harder to master.. 

	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/1cbdc9d0f792efb6dbcf87625ac564e9136cd322.png[/img]

	We have a few areas that we want to focus on to accomplish this. In terms of content, we plan to delve deeper into the stories surrounding Charlie and Wagstaff, and explore the impact of their actions on The Constant. The introduction of late-game world challenges will change The Constant in ways that players will need to adapt to, either by working with or against them. This will also provide Survivors with the opportunity to discover new resources and items that will be vital for their survival as they progress throughout all areas of the game. 

	Some of this has been introduced as part of the Wilson Refresh, and we will continue to build upon them throughout the year.

	[b]And what about the newer players?[/b]
	Something that we have seen time and time again is that some newer players have a hard time understanding what they should be doing, or where they should be going and may become frustrated or miss a lot of content if they don’t know what else is out there for them. With this in mind, we are going to work toward making it a bit easier to understand what should be happening in the game without necessarily making the game easier. 

	To that end we will be working on additions to the compendium and other elements of the game that will provide more information about what is happening, as well as progress indicators that help players see themselves grow through what they have learned in the game. 

	Some of you may have noticed that some elements of the Wilson Refresh are a part of this effort as well. Wilson now acts as a sort of guide through the progression of the game, without directly telling the player what to do, his new skill tree can guide a player toward long term goals as they explore the world. He’s still rather vanilla, he just has some sprinkles now. Nothing too intimidating to a new player.

	It should also be said that the “Core Game Enhancement” updates are foundational and are likely to grow and change over time. This means that we’ll implement systems or features that we can tweak or add to over time and while it’s probably not accurate to call these QOL updates, they will be Quality of Life oriented in the sense that they are meant to make the overall game better for most players, but not always by improving existing systems. 

	[b]What’s next?[/b]
	The Wilson Refresh will be released Thursday and the update following that is currently planned for April will be a content update as part of the new Story Arc. This will be the first content update as part of this roadmap and should be quite interesting.

notes.title: The Year of the Bunnyman Has Arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/40944738c697ca8c91dadb43993747ebcef1742f.gif[/img]
Let's get ready to slumber!! The Year of the Bunnyman has begun!

To celebrate the Year of the Bunnyman we have added a new activity in the game, some new item drops and some new streaming items!

[list]
[*] Summon Cozy Bunnymen to the surface for a slumber party.
[*] Join in the frivolity of pillow fighting and "spin the carrot".
[*] Formally challenge one or more Bunnymen to a Pillow Fighting Pit for a chance to win Lucky Gold Nuggets.
[*] Buy different grades of Pillow to both arm and armor yourself for the Pit.
[*] Purchase old items and new snacks as well as new Rabbit Lamps to decorate your base.
[/list]
We've also added some new skins to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/dc8d381cd357ff991d154187e7b1e8bed95dbd49.png[/img]

The Masquerader Survivors Chest can be purchased in a chest for $8.99 usd and contains skins for: Willow, Warly, Wortox, Wes, and Woodie. As always, these items will be available as drops in game and are also weaveable using spool. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/311bf4b672629c53d1feb1559d9721c6bf9f3cf4.png[/img]

The Mosaic Mushlamp will join the Art Nouveau collection. Check out the post for more details. 

And that's it for now. The team is well on its way to finishing out the roadmap and some of the team is even working on content for the 2023 content schedule. We'll have a new roadmap coming up rather soon. You're going to need to hold out a little longer but I promise[url=https://accounts.klei.com/link/soclose],[/url] it will be worth the wait. Bold statement, I know but we're pretty excited and we think you will be too. See you next time!

notes.title: Winter's Feast is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/8d52e29aac86684bf1593ca520feca526ee52333.png[/img]
[h3]Winter's Feast[/h3]
The table is set for Winter’s Feast, and this year something new is being cooked up for our Survivors. They're going to have to work for it, of course.

Lots of festive activities provide entertainment for all our Survivors. Visit the Deerclops, See Klaus's Gem Deer! There's fun, food, and treats from the Festive Table, or start your own bakery. And lots more. Winter's feast is fun, forest, and fantasy all rolled into one!

[h3]An Uncommon Holiday[/h3]
Winter skins have appeared to get our survivors into the winter spirit, and for a limited time, the chances of receiving a rare gift have been substantially increased!

[h3]Festive Holiday Attire[/h3]
For the duration of the Winter's Feast event, players will have access to a free set of skins. The Yuletide Overcoat, Yuletide Frock, Jingly Tophat, Gingerbread Chest, and the Plum Pudding Cap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/552d874e14ff6c8a629647d80a89f80c673df168.png[/img]

[h3]New Snowfallen Skins[/h3]
And keeping with Winter tradition, we have added new skins to the Snowfallen collection.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/2821e4ed18ea853581cdbba0c853cbb7048da631.png[/img]

[b]Complete Snowfallen Survivors Chest[/b] ($15.99)
This Snowfallen Chest contains the complete Snowfallen series of survivor skins.

[b]Snowfallen Survivors Chest, Part III [/b]($9.99)
This Snowfallen Chest contains skins for: Woodie, Wes, Maxwell, Wigfrid, Wormwood, Wurt, and Wanda.
 
[h3]Login Bonus Item:[/h3]
And finally, players who login during the event will also be granted the Winter Hibearnation Vest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/85c64b4fdbe4bb3f2c0b15aecc45cc4b64ac7733.png[/img]

[h3]And finally![/h3]
We're getting ready for a long Winter's Nap - but when we return we're going to have the next Lunar New Year event and it's almost time for our final character refresh and a new Roadmap! 

DST just keeps getting bigger and better every year and we're looking forward to our new plans in 2023 and we can't wait to share. 

That's it for now, we hope you all have a great Winter's Feast and we'll [url=https://accounts.klei.com/link/bye2022]see you next year[/url]!

notes.title: [Game Update] - 532704 & 534050 Updated 11/30/2022
notes.content:
[h3]Bug Fixes - 11/30/2022[/h3]
[list][*] Fixed controller bug where Stop action sometimes does not show when using Magician’s Top Hat.
[*] Fixed bug with Tackle Box being dropped at the wrong location when opened out of the shadow dimensional storage.
[*] When pirate boats despawn, they will no longer remove things around them that aren’t actually on the boat.
[*] Pirate stash is now inspectable.
[*] Fixed save/load issues with pirate stash.
[*] Fixed save/load issues with Terrarium.
[*] Fixed bugs with Eye/Twins of Terror if they were despawned off-screen.
[*] Fixed bugs with Terrarium behavior if Twins of Terror are killed right as they are trying to fly away in the morning.
[*] Fixed bug with Bee Queen’s pathfinding failing when over the ocean or boats.

	The former Nightmare King suddenly finds himself facing his past... and a choice about his future. Everyone take your seats, the Amazing Maxwell's next act is about to begin.

	[b]Changes[/b]
[list]	[*]		Codex Umbra is now a spell book that feeds off of Sanity and Nightmare Fuel only.	[/*]	[*]		Added a spell wheel UI for reading the Codex Umbra in your inventory.	[/*]	[*]		Maxwell now summons the following shadow puppets:		[list]			[*]				Shadow Servant			[/*]			[*]				Shadow Duelist			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Maxwell now controls up to six puppets at a time.	[/*]	[*]		These improved puppets automatically aggro or work within their summoned area for a set duration before expiring.	[/*]	[*]		Equipping shadowy equipment will increase the power of Shadow Duelists.		[list]			[*]				This includes, but is not limited to, most things crafted from Shadow Magic or Ancient Pseudoscience.			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		Maxwell now summons the following crowd control shadows:		[list]			[*]				Shadow Sneak			[/*]			[*]				Shadow Prison			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		All shadows can be summoned on the ocean.	[/*]	[*]		Maxwell can craft the Magician's Top Hat and Magician’s Chest.	[/*]	[*]		Magician's Top Hat, Magician's Chest, and Shadow Chester are all connected to one shadow dimensional storage in the Forest, and another one while in the Caves.	[/*][/list]
	[b]Additional changes[/b]
[list]	[*]		Controller twin-stick aiming for AoE targeting spells.	[/*]	[*]		Inventory bar actions, such as dropping, refuelling, and repairing items, can now be performed on controllers while auto-pause is enabled.	[/*]	[*]		AoE attack hit boxes for Ancient Sentrypede, Eye of Terror, Twins of Terror, and Celestial Champion have been updated to account for the size of their targets.	[/*]	[*]		Adjusted the tracking of Twins of Terror’s dash attacks accordingly.	[/*][/list]
	As always, a big Thank You to all players that checked out the refresh during beta and submitting their feedback and bug reports!

	[b]New Skins![/b]
	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/c6866b5eefcca34dfc7490eb14c0132cd7c8ebd6.png[/img]

	[b]Maxwell Deluxe Wardrobe[/b] ($10.99 / 19 RMB)
	This Deluxe Wardrobe contains Maxwell's complete set of Guest of Honor, Roseate, Survivor, Untriumphant, and Dark Wizard skin items.

	[b]Maxwell Dark Wizard Chest [/b]($3.99 / 8 RMB)
	This Dark Wizard's Chest contains the following skin items: Cursed Cloak, Cursed Sabre, and Showman's Shadow Hat.

	[b]New Twitch Drops![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/3cd13bcf3c860f82e16fb7d468ed2b2fe684c5da.png[/img]

	We're offering a new set of streaming drops over on Twitch.tv. [url=http://klei.gg/currentdrop]Check out this post for details[/url].

[b]Rhymes with Play[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6835324/4b39b8e5792eb1b6fd7f7ceb165b8464276159e5.png[/img]	

Make sure to join us for another Rhymes with Play Dev stream this Thursday. We'll be checking out the Maxwell refresh with our hosts Vito and Hailey. https://twitch.tv/kleientertainment


	[b]And that's it for now![/b]

	As we approach the end of the year we still have a bit more to go to finish out the 2022(3) roadmap. We have been talking internally about what's coming up in the next roadmap and while we still have some details to iron out, we're already very excited about 2023! We have been watching the feedback from players regarding the long-term hopes for the game. While it's going to be difficult to wait for more info, it's going to be even harder for us to keep it under wraps, but we'll be posting up a new roadmap at the beginning of next year[url=https://accounts.klei.com/link/YouAskedForIt]![/url]  

	 
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/322330/view/3484126239531329630

	Along with looking forward, this time of the year we also reflect on what we’ve done. It’s been a fantastic adventure not just this year, but each year since we launched Don’t Starve Together back in 2016. 

	The Steam awards have once again opened for nominations, and we thought we’d ask players to please consider nominating Don't Starve Together for the Steam Awards 2022 in the Labor of Love category.
